    Bridge from the proof library to the standalone statements #

    This file proves the five standalone predicates defined in EFiniteCharacterizations/Statement.lean from the library:

    • proveArbitraryField (Theorem A(I)): proved from equivalences_arbitraryField (Characterizations/Equivalences.lean), using isEFinite_iff_twoTermThickGeneration (Silting/ThickSubcategories/ThickGenerationCriterion.lean) for (thick-gen).
    • proveInfiniteField (Theorem A(II), counterpart to equivalences_infiniteField): proved directly from isEFinite_iff_finite_brickClassesOfClass and isEFinite_iff_finite_stableClassesOfClass (Characterizations/FixedClassFiniteness.lean).
    • proveAlgebraicallyClosedField (Theorem A(III), counterpart to equivalences_algebraicallyClosedField): constructs a split basic Morita chart via basicPresentation and proves chart invariance from atMostOneKingClosedPoint_of_isEFinite, isEFinite_iff_kingClosedPoints, and isEFinite_iff_open_vertex_loci (Geometry/).
    • proveRankTwo (Theorem B): proved from rankTwoEquivalences (Silting/Fans/RankTwoTauTilting.lean).
    • proveBrickDiscreteMultiplicityFree (Corollary C, counterpart to brick_discrete_iff_multiplicityFree): combines isEFinite_iff_finite_brickClassesOfClass with rank_componentWeightSpace_le_one_of_isEFinite and isEFinite_iff_multiplicityFree (Geometry/ComponentMultiplicity.lean).
